# existence creation event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:existenceCreationEvent`](gmeow-existenceCreationEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/existenceCreationEvent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lifecycle`](../../slices/lifecycle.md)

The creation event associated with this existence record. Optional: an [`EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) may record only an interval when the creation event is unknown.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) -> [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)

Use [`gmeow:existenceCreationEvent`](gmeow-existenceCreationEvent.md) from [`gmeow:EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) to [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on an [`EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) to name its creation event when the existence claim is reified and the bringing-into-being is known.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it on the flat form (use [`gmeow:hasCreationEvent`](gmeow-hasCreationEvent.md) directly on the entity) and do not require it — an existence record may carry only an interval when the creation event is unknown.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:existenceCreationEvent`](gmeow-existenceCreationEvent.md) from the [`EntityExistence`](../classes/gmeow-EntityExistence.md) to a [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) co-typed with the appropriate [`EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md); pair with [`gmeow:existenceDestructionEvent`](gmeow-existenceDestructionEvent.md) and the interval to complete the reified record.
